description:
Quick check of an Amazon listing by its ASIN or product link: we read the public listing, detect its Scan
category and return the same as wintraits_chequeo_rapido.
(Chequeo rápido de una ficha de Amazon por su ASIN o enlace.)

`ficha_leida` gives the ASIN, the detected category and where its price sits against the middle half of best
sellers (`por_debajo`, `dentro`, `por_encima`). The listing's text and price are not returned. If the product is
not in a category with Scan published, it returns an error with the available categories: then use
wintraits_chequeo_rapido with the pasted listing and the closest category.

Args:
    asin_o_enlace: ASIN (10 characters, e.g. "B0XXXXXXXX") or Amazon product link (its country wins over `pais`).
    pais: country code when only the ASIN is given (default "ES").
    lang: "es" (default) or "en".

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-01-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-ene-2027).
name: wintraits_chequeo_asin
